1. 决策者协议优化：给 route-task.ps1 增加结构化分配规则
优化结论：DeepSeek 不应该每次凭经验判断“谁来做”，而应该由 route-task.ps1 输出固定的 delegation 字段：主执行者、辅助审查者、是否需要老板确认、必须跑哪些验收。

PowerShell# 插入到 route-task.ps1 的 helper 区域# 作用：根据任务类型、风险、文件、pipeline 状态，给出明确 agent 分配function Get-PipelineFallbackStatus { Set-StrictMode -Version 2.0 $ErrorActionPreference = "Continue" try { $healthPath = Join-Path $root ".claude\run-state\pipeline-health.json" if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $healthPath)) { return [pscustomobject]@{ selected = "GPT-5.5" primary_available = $true fallback_level = "unknown" } } return (Get-Content -LiteralPath $healthPath -Raw -Encoding UTF8 | ConvertFrom-Json) } catch { return [pscustomobject]@{ selected = "GPT-5.5" primary_available = $true fallback_level = "fail-open" } }}function Resolve-Delegation { param( [string]$Task = "", [string[]]$ChangedFiles = @(), [string]$RiskLevel = "L1" ) Set-StrictMode -Version 2.0 $ErrorActionPreference = "Continue" $pipeline = Get-PipelineFallbackStatus $taskText = [string]$Task $files = @($ChangedFiles) $isHookOrGate = [bool](@($files | Where-Object { $_ -match "\\.claude\\hooks\\" -or $_ -match "block-dangerous|stop-gate|posttool-recorder|run-state\.lib|evidence-check|close-run|health\.ps1" }).Count -gt 0) $isComplexCode = ( $taskText -match "复杂|重构|多文件|架构|pipeline|状态机|hook|门禁|fallback|并发|自动化" -or $files.Count -ge 3 -or $isHookOrGate ) $isSmallPatch = ( $taskText -match "小修|补丁|一两行|正则|路径|拼写|简单" -and $files.Count -le 2 -and -not $isHookOrGate ) $isVision = ( $taskText -match "截图|视觉|图片|GUI|界面|桌面|浏览器画面" ) $isLargeContext = ( $taskText -match "审计|全量|完整体系|大上下文|对照|梳理|总结" -or $files.Count -ge 8 ) $primary = "DeepSeek" $reviewer = "DeepSeek" $assistant = "" $mode = "direct" $reason = "simple task; DeepSeek can execute directly" $requiredChecks = @("evidence-check run-complete") $requiresBossApproval = $false if ($isVision) { $primary = "豆包Vision" $reviewer = "DeepSeek" $mode = "vision" $reason = "vision/gui task requires visual model" $requiredChecks = @("gui-probe", "screenshot evidence", "evidence-check run-complete") } elseif ($isHookOrGate -or $RiskLevel -in @("L3", "L4", "L5")) { $primary = if ($pipeline.selected) { [string]$pipeline.selected } else { "GPT-5.5" } $reviewer = "DeepSeek" $assistant = "GLM-5.2" $mode = "high-risk-code" $reason = "hook/gate/state change requires GPT-grade code plus DeepSeek protocol review" $requiredChecks = @( "ps-guard", "test-automation-loop", "test-negative-gates", "health", "evidence-check run-complete" ) $requiresBossApproval = ($RiskLevel -in @("L4", "L5")) } elseif ($isComplexCode) { $primary = if ($pipeline.selected) { [string]$pipeline.selected } else { "GPT-5.5" } $reviewer = "DeepSeek" $assistant = if ($isLargeContext) { "GLM-5.2" } else { "" } $mode = "complex-code" $reason = "complex/multi-file code should be delegated to strongest available external coder" $requiredChecks = @("ps-guard", "verify", "smoke", "evidence-check run-complete") } elseif ($isSmallPatch) { $primary = "Ollama qwen2.5-coder" $reviewer = "DeepSeek" $mode = "small-patch" $reason = "small code patch suitable for local coder" $requiredChecks = @("ps-guard", "targeted test", "evidence-check run-complete") } elseif ($isLargeContext) { $primary = "GLM-5.2" $reviewer = "DeepSeek" $mode = "large-context-review" $reason = "large-context audit/review task" $requiredChecks = @("review summary", "evidence-check run-complete") } return [pscustomobject]@{ primary_agent = $primary reviewer = $reviewer assistant_agent = $assistant mode = $mode reason = $reason risk_level = $RiskLevel required_checks = $requiredChecks requires_boss_approval = $requiresBossApproval pipeline_selected = $pipeline.selected pipeline_fallback = $pipeline.fallback_level }}# 在 route-task.ps1 生成 capability-plan / route 输出前加入：# $delegation = Resolve-Delegation -Task $Task -ChangedFiles 2. PreCompact / SessionStart 压缩恢复：保存“恢复决策所需字段”
优化结论：当前只存 current.json 快照和 health 等级还不够。压缩恢复时最重要的是让 DeepSeek 立刻知道：当前任务、上次路由、最近 pipeline 状态、最近 mem0 查询、最近能力调用。不要存全量日志，只存摘要和 tail。
2-A：precompact-save.ps1 增加字段
改动文件：D:\Code\.claude\hooks\precompact-save.ps1
PowerShell# 插入到 precompact-save.ps1 写 compact-info.json 之前# 假设已有 $root / $stateDir / $compactInfo 变量；如果变量名不同，按现有变量替换function Read-JsonSafe { param([string]$Path) try { if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $Path) { return (Get-Content -LiteralPath $Path -Raw -Encoding UTF8 | ConvertFrom-Json) } } catch { return $null } return $null}function Read-JsonlTailSafe { param( [string]$Path, [int]$Count = 10 ) try { if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $Path)) { return @() } $lines = @(Get-Content -LiteralPath $Path -Encoding UTF8 | Select-Object -Last $Count) $items = @() foreach ($line in $lines) { if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($line)) { continue } try { $items += ($line | ConvertFrom-Json) } catch { continue } } return $items } catch { return @() }}function Add-OrSetProp { param( [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][object]$Object, [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Name, [object]$Value ) if ($Object.PSObject.Properties.Name -contains $Name) { $Object.$Name = $Value } else { $Object | Add-Member -NotePropertyName $Name -NotePropertyValue $Value }}$currentPath = Join-Path $root ".claude\run-state\current.json"$pipelineHealthPath = Join-Path $root ".claude\run-state\pipeline-health.json"$capabilityPlanPath = Join-Path $root ".claude\run-state\capability-plan.json"$capabilityUsagePath = Join-Path $root ".claude\run-state\capability-usage.jsonl"$mem0LastQueryPath = Join-Path $root ".claude\run-state\mem0-last-query.json"$automationLoopPath = Join-Path $root ".claude\run-state\automation-loop-test.json"$negativeGatesPath = Join-Path $root ".claude\run-state\negative-gates-test.json"$current = Read-JsonSafe -Path $currentPath$pipeline = Read-JsonSafe -Path $pipelineHealthPath$capabilityPlan = Read-JsonSafe -Path $capabilityPlanPath$mem0LastQuery = Read-JsonSafe -Path $mem0LastQueryPath$automationLoop = Read-JsonSafe -Path $automationLoopPath$negativeGates = Read-JsonSafe -Path $negativeGatesPath$usageTail = @(Read-JsonlTailSafe -Path $capabilityUsagePath -Count 15)$taskContext = [ordered]@{ run_id = "" task = "" phase = "" task_started = $false maintenance_mode = $false files_modified = $false modified_files = @() scripts_created = @() scripts_executed = @() tests_run = $false evidence_collected = $false close_run_done = $false guard_used = $false}if ($null -ne $current) { foreach ($k in @($taskContext.Keys)) { if ($current.PSObject.Properties.Name -contains $k) { $taskContext[$k] = $current.$k } }}$restoreContext = [ordered]@{ saved_at = (Get-Date).ToString("s") restore_priority = @( "continue current run if close_run_done=false", "run evidence-check run-complete before close-run", "respect maintenance_mode if true", "use pipeline fallback if GPT-5.5 unavailable" ) task_context = $taskContext pipeline_health = $pipeline capability_plan = $capabilityPlan mem0_last_query = $mem0LastQuery capability_usage_tail = $usageTail last_tests = [ordered]@{ automation_loop = $automationLoop negative_gates = $negativeGates }}Add-OrSetProp -Object $compactInfo -Name "restore_context" -Value $restoreContext
2-B：session-start-restore.ps1 注入更有用的 additionalContext
改动文件：D:\Code\.claude\hooks\session-start-restore.ps1
PowerShell# 插入到读取 compact-info.json 后、生成 additionalContext 前# 假设已有 $compactInfo 变量；如果当前文件变量名不同，按现有变量替换function ConvertTo-CompactLine { param([object]$Value) try { if ($null -eq $Value) { return "" } if ($Value -is [string]) { return $Value } return (($Value | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8 -Compress) -replace "\s+", " ") } catch { return "" }}$restore = $nullif ($compactInfo.PSObject.Properties.Name -contains "restore_context") { $restore = $compactInfo.restore_context}if ($null -ne $restore) { $task = $restore.task_context $pipeline = $restore.pipeline_health $plan = $restore.capability_plan $lines = @() $lines += "【压缩恢复上下文】" $lines += "saved_at: $($restore.saved_at)" if ($null -ne $task) { $lines += "run_id: $($task.run_id)" $lines += "task: $($task.task)" $lines += "phase: $($task.phase)" $lines += "task_started: $($task.task_started)" $lines += "maintenance_mode: $($task.maintenance_mode)" $lines += "tests_run/evidence/close: $($task.tests_run)/$($task.evidence_collected)/$($task.close_run_done)" $lines += "modified_files: $((@($task.modified_files) | Select-Object -First 8) -join ', ')" $lines += "scripts_created: $((@($task.scripts_created) | Select-Object -First 8) -join ', ')" } if ($null -ne $pipeline) { $lines += "pipeline: selected=$($pipeline.selected), fallback=$($pipeline.fallback_level), primary_available=$($pipeline.primary_available)" } if ($null -ne $plan) { $lines += "capability_plan: " + (ConvertTo-CompactLine -Value $plan) } if ($null -ne $restore.mem0_last_query) { $lines += "mem0_last_query: " + (ConvertTo-CompactLine -Value $restore.mem0_last_query) } if ($null -ne $restore.capability_usage_tail) { $tail = @($restore.capability_usage_tail | Select-Object -Last 5 | ForEach-Object { "$($_.script):exit=$($_.exit_code)" }) $lines += "capability_usage_tail: $($tail -join '; ')" } $lines += "恢复指令: 继续前先看 maintenance_mode / tests_run / close_run_done；如未闭环，先 evidence-check run-complete，再 close-run。" $additionalContext = ($lines -join "`n")}# 后续沿用现有逻辑，把 $additionalContext 注入 SessionStart 输出

3. Maintenance 模式优化：start 阶段先证明 Hook 健康
优化结论：维护模式不能在未知坏状态下开始。maintenance-start.ps1 应先跑 ps-guard 检查 3 个 hook，只有“改之前是健康的”，才进入维护。否则维护完成后无法判断是新改坏的，还是原本就坏。
改动文件：D:\Code\maintenance-start.ps1
PowerShell# 插入到 maintenance-start.ps1 创建 allow-maintenance.once 之前# 作用：进入维护模式前先验证当前 3 个 Hook 可解析、可过 ps-guardfunction Invoke-PreMaintenanceGuard { param( [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Root ) Set-StrictMode -Version 2.0 $ErrorActionPreference = "Continue" $psGuard = Join-Path $Root "ai-infra\scripts\ps-guard.ps1" $hookPaths = @( (Join-Path $Root ".claude\hooks\stop-gate.ps1"), (Join-Path $Root ".claude\hooks\posttool-recorder.ps1"), (Join-Path $Root ".claude\hooks\block-dangerous.ps1") ) $results = @() foreach ($hookPath in $hookPaths) { $name = Split-Path -Leaf $hookPath $output = @() $exitCode = 1 try { if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $hookPath)) { $results += [pscustomobject]@{ name = $name ok = $false exit_code = 127 output = @("missing hook: $hookPath") } continue } if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $psGuard)) { $results += [pscustomobject]@{ name = $name ok = $false exit_code = 127 output = @("missing ps-guard: $psGuard") } continue } $output = @(& pwsh -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File $psGuard $hookPath 2>&1 | ForEach-Object { [string]$_ }) $exitCode = $LASTEXITCODE if ($null -eq $exitCode) { $exitCode = 0 } $results += [pscustomobject]@{ name = $name ok = ($exitCode -eq 0) exit_code = $exitCode output = $output } } catch { $results += [pscustomobject]@{ name = $name ok = $false exit_code = 1 output = @($_.Exception.Message) } } } $failed = @($results | Where-Object { -not $_.ok }) return [pscustomobject]@{ ok = ($failed.Count -eq 0) results = $results failed = $failed }}$preGuard = Invoke-PreMaintenanceGuard -Root $root$preReportPath = Join-Path $root ".claude\run-state\pre-maintenance-guard.json"try { $preReportDir = Split-Path -Parent $preReportPath if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $preReportDir)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $preReportDir -Force | Out-Null } $preGuard | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 20 | Set-Content -LiteralPath $preReportPath -Encoding UTF8}catch { Write-Host ("WARN: 写 pre-maintenance guard 报告失败: " + $_.Exception.Message)}if (-not $preGuard.ok) { Write-Host "拒绝进入维护模式：当前 Hook 在修改前已不健康。请先修复基础状态。" foreach ($item in @($preGuard.failed)) { Write-Host ("- {0}: exit={1}" -f $item.name, $item.exit_code) if ($item.output) { Write-Host (($item.output | Select-Object -First 20) -join "`n") } } exit 1}Write-Host "pre-maintenance guard OK: 当前 Hook 修改前健康"
再补一小段：备份时保存 hash，便于 close 阶段对比
同文件插入到备份 hook 后面：
PowerShell# maintenance-start.ps1: 备份 hook 后追加 hash manifesttry { $hashManifest = @() foreach ($hookPath in $hookPaths) { if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $hookPath) { $hashManifest += [pscustomobject]@{ name = Split-Path -Leaf $hookPath path = $hookPath sha256 = (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $hookPath -Algorithm SHA256).Hash captured_at = (Get-Date).ToString("s") } } } $hashManifestPath = Join-Path $baselineDir "hook-hashes.pre-maintenance.json" $hashManifest | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10 | Set-Content -LiteralPath $hashManifestPath -Encoding UTF8}catch { Write-Host ("WARN: pre-maintenance hook hash 保存失败: " + $_.Exception.Message)}

总结判断

决策者协议：补 Resolve-Delegation，让 DeepSeek 的分配从经验判断升级为结构化路由，复杂代码走 GPT-5.5，小补丁走 Ollama，大上下文走 GLM，视觉走豆包，高风险必须 DeepSeek 复核。

压缩恢复：补 restore_context，保存当前任务、pipeline、capability plan、mem0 最近查询、usage tail，让 SessionStart 恢复后能直接继续，不需要重新摸索。

维护模式：maintenance-start 前置跑 ps-guard，证明修改前 Hook 健康；否则拒绝进入维护模式，避免“带病维护”。
